exposure: maternal extreme flexure and hip abduction combined with contralateral side-lying
outcome: correction of persistent foetal occipito-posterior position
duration between initial and successful correction
cohort: 226 pregnant women with persistent foetal occipito-posterior position
finding: Maternal extreme flexure and hip abduction combined with contralateral side-lying was more effective in correcting persistent foetal occipito-posterior position compared to contralateral side-lying alone.
